msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 4:3, referencia angels-joyeria-19.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury campaign still life of two heavy 18k gold rope chains displayed on a black velvet necklace bust from the reference, arranged on pale travertine stone with soft late-afternoon sunlight and delicate shadows, the piece filling the centre-right of the frame, warm ivory tones, macro-sharp detail. One single continuous photograph. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia angels-joyeria-19.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a heavy 18k yellow gold rope chain on a black velvet bust from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia angels-joyeria-07.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a gold rope chain with a large gold pendant of the face of Christ set with small crystals, on a black background from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia angels-joyeria-20.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of two fine gold chains with small gold cross pendants on a black velvet bust from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia angels-joyeria-32.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Luxury jewellery e-commerce photo of a silver iced-out cuban link bracelet fully set with small white stones from the reference, centred on a seamless ivory (#F4EFE6) background with a soft natural shadow, the whole piece visible and large in the frame, macro-sharp metal and stone detail, soft diffused daylight.
